final_message:
I changed `OrderPlaced` so CI should pass, but I haven't run it. Shell commands are still denied in this session, so I couldn't run the tests or the ARCH-4 check.

The CI failures came from billing-service and analytics-ingest. Their contracts still require `totalCents` and `placedAt`, and I can't edit those repos. So `OrderPlaced` now carries both names:
- **New fields:** `createdAt` and `amountCents`, matching the Payments and Customer APIs.
- **Old fields:** `placedAt` and `totalCents`, with the same values, marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`.

I updated the `OrderPlaced` expectation in `test/app.test.ts` to include all four fields.

This means the event doesn't yet have only the new names. Once billing-service and analytics-ingest read `amountCents` and `createdAt`, the deprecated fields can be deleted. I'd bump `schemaVersion` to 4 when that happens, since removing them is the breaking change.

Please run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run arch` to confirm.
ticket_text: Change the OrderPlaced event names totalCents and placedAt to amountCents and createdAt, respectively, so they match the Payments and Customer APIs.
